title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 32
paragraphs: Then the commanders of the Persians proved not false to the threats with which they had threatened the Ionians when they were encamped opposite each other; for when they conquered the cities, they chose the most comely of the boys and made eunuchs of them by castration, and the fairest of the maidens they carried off by force to the king. And not only this, but they also burned the cities together with the temples. Thus for the third time had the Ionians been reduced to slavery: first by the Lydians, and then twice in succession by the Persians.
